about:
Atlantic Cable operates from Exeter, New Hampshire, as a wholesale supplier of cables and connectivity accessories. The company serves the wholesale market with a broad inventory and custom assembly capabilities.

The company stocks thousands of items across hundreds of product lines, including Ethernet patch cables, fiber optic components, HDMI, USB, coaxial, and audio cables. In addition to off-the-shelf products, Atlantic Cable custom-builds cables and accessories in-house, allowing it to fulfill specific customer requirements. Orders placed before 4:30 p.m. EST ship the same day, and there is no minimum order quantity.

Its customer base consists primarily of wholesale buyers, resellers, and installers in telecommunications, data communications, audio/video, and networking sectors. The company emphasizes technically trained customer service representatives to support product selection and custom projects.

Atlantic Cable differentiates itself by purchasing directly from manufacturers and acting as its own distributor, which it says keeps pricing competitive. The business was built on responding to customer demand for custom-created products and maintaining a combination of price and service that it describes as the best value in the industry.
